notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the tutorial appeared out of bounds on lower resolution screens.

notes.title: Launching on Steam August 20th!
notes.content:
[p]Aleato releases August 20th!

I’m so thrilled that Aleato is finally launching on Steam this August 20th! It’s been a wild ride getting this roguelike dice game finished, and seeing it come together feels like such a huge milestone for me. I can’t wait for everyone to jump in, roll some dice and hopefully creating some absurd builds. 

It’s just pure joy knowing this game is ready to share. Hope you’re as excited as I am to play it! 

//Carl[/p]
